name: Billstride
description: Official hosted MCP server for Billstride, pay-per-invoice invoicing. Create, send and track invoices from a conversation: reuse last month's invoice, chase overdue payments, see revenue, and export e-invoices (ZUGFeRD, XRechnung) and DATEV. 27 tools, 25 countries including the US, Canada and the EU. Open sign-up; the first invoice is free, then pay per invoice. Authenticates with OAuth 2.1 (discovery and dynamic client registration).
author: superview llc
